entities.summary: Tomàs Rosés was a banker and president of FC Barcelona from 1929 to 1930. A banker by trade, Rosés became the 17th president of FC Barcelona on 23 March 1929, and presided over the club as they won a Catalan Championship and the inaugural edition of La Liga, as the team won the 1929 La Liga.
